comparisons.peer_topic: Level 3 hedge interaction and revenue inclusion
comparisons.peer_summary: Realized and unrealized gains/losses for Level 3 items do not reflect related gains/losses on hedging instruments in Level 1 or 2, and total gains/losses are primarily included in Trading revenues.
comparisons.comparison: Both GS and MS address the interaction between Level 3 gains/losses and hedging instruments, as well as the revenue classification. MS explicitly states that reported Level 3 gains/losses do not reflect related gains/losses on hedging instruments in Level 1 or 2, and total gains/losses are primarily included in Trading revenues. GS provides a rollforward of net losses ($143 million in 2023) split into realized gains and unrealized losses, reported in other principal transactions and interest income, but does not explicitly exclude hedging instrument effects in the provided summary text, highlighting a difference in disclosure granularity regarding hedging interactions.

sentences.text: The net realized and unrealized losses on level 3 loans of $143 million (reflecting $26 million of net realized gains and $169 million of net unrealized losses) for 2023 included gains/(losses) of $(152) million reported in other principal transactions and $9 million reported in interest income.

The realized and unrealized gains or losses for assets and liabilities within the Level 3 category presented in the previous tables do not reflect the related realized and unrealized gains or losses on hedging instruments that have been classified by the Firm within the Level 1 and/or Level 2 categories.
Total realized and unrealized gains (losses) are primarily included in Trading revenues in the income statement.
